name: Santa Monica Place
description: Santa Monica Place is a premier three-level open-air shopping destination featuring luxury and contemporary retailers, upscale dining, and entertainment options just blocks from the Pacific Ocean and iconic Santa Monica Pier. Designed by renowned architect Frank Gehry and renovated in 2010, this lifestyle center combines high-end shopping with stunning ocean views and Southern California's indoor-outdoor lifestyle. The center attracts both locals and tourists seeking a sophisticated retail experience in one of Los Angeles' most desirable beach communities.
demographics: Affluent coastal community with high disposable income, strong tourist traffic from both domestic and international visitors, predominantly ages 25-55 with focus on fashion-conscious consumers and entertainment seekers
summary: An upscale open-air lifestyle center in downtown Santa Monica featuring luxury shopping, oceanview dining, and contemporary architecture steps from the Pacific Ocean.
